name: UH Real Estate Investment Trust
source: CRON 2026-11-21: UPDC Real Estate Investment Trust unaudited statement of comprehensive income for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library, page 3, 30 Sep 2026 column), printed in thousands of naira and scaled to naira. Total revenue of 3,380,496 thousand equals the sum of the printed rental income of 2,407,097 thousand, interest income on bank deposits of 953,562 thousand, interest income on financial assets at fair value through profit or loss of 8,949 thousand and other income of 10,888 thousand. A trust carries no cost of sales and no finance cost, so gross profit is left blank. Total revenue plus the printed impairment reversal of 73,256 thousand less operating expenses of 780,039 thousand equals the printed increase in net assets attributable to unitholders of 2,673,713 thousand, which is the trust profit for the period; no income tax was charged. EPS is the printed basic earnings per unit of 1.00 naira. | CRON 20261014: UH Real Estate Investment Trust statement of comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Jun-26 column, thousands of naira scaled to naira. Total income less distribution, admin and other expenses equals the printed net income. The trust charged no tax and reports no financial charges, so operating profit, profit before tax and net income are the same printed figure. Basic earnings per share stored in naira. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929: audited FY2024 statement of comprehensive income (N'000) | CRON 20261002: EPS filled from UH Real Estate Investment Trust five-year financial summary page 43 (columns 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020), printed "Basic earnings per share (N)" as 5.56, 3.49, 2.29, 2.09, 2.01. The first four agree with the stored cells, so the FY2020 figure 2.01 is taken from the same source. Ties: stored FY2020 net profit 377,158,000 divided by 2.01 implies 187.6m units, consistent with the 188.1m units implied by the stored FY2021 pair. Revenue for FY2022, FY2021 and FY2020 taken from the five year financial summary (page 43) of UH Real Estate Investment Trust reports and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, line Investment income, columns 2022, 2021 and 2020, printed in N'000 and stored as absolute NGN. The same table reproduces the stored FY2024 (1,277,776) and FY2023 (884,278) revenue exactly, which confirms the row mapping and the scaling. | CRON 20261116 NGX filing fill: FY2025 Revenue filled from the issuer filing; FY2025 Operating Expenses filled from the issuer filing; FY2025 Net Finance Costs filled from the issuer filing; FY2025 Profit Before Tax filled from the issuer filing; FY2025 Net Profit filled from the issuer filing; FY2025 EPS filled from the issuer filing; H1 2026 Income Tax filled from the issuer filing; H1 2026 Net Finance Costs filled from the issuer filing. Each value is read from the printed statement named in repairs, not derived. | CRON 20261116: FY2025 Income Tax set to nil from the audited statement, whose Taxation row carries no figure.
